svg.title: VoluStep Google Play icon
svg.desc: A rising four-point volume mapping curve with one green active point on a dark background.
svg.metadata: Brand: VoluStep Source audit: app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_launcher_foreground.xml, app/src/main/res/values/colors.xml, and app/src/main/java/dev/spcdts/volumemapper/ui/Theme.kt.
